You learn by doing, not just listening.

Six hands-on experiences take BDI students out of the classroom and into real businesses.

Grassroots Exploration

Live in Tier-3 and Tier-4 cities and study ground-level challenges across MSME, Education and Agriculture.

ProtoLab

Ideate, build prototypes and test solutions for business challenges, one iteration at a time.

Case competitions

Solve real business scenarios and present directly to C-level executives and CEOs.

Global Citizen Leadership

On-site industry engagement to find core operational issues and design actionable fixes.

Ethnographic study

Visit businesses to observe, research and map operational pain points.

International immersion

Join global business summits and learn across cultures.

What you study, trimester by trimester.

Pick a trimester to see its subjects. Design subjects like Information Design and UI/UX sit alongside finance, analytics and marketing.
